wonder_assumptions: The waiting zone is zone 'inspection' and the stop line is line 'packing_entry'.
'Wait at least 1.5 seconds' is interpreted as 1500 ms of continuous DWELL in 'inspection' while stopped/still, so max_speed is 0.05.
Cars travel from bottom-right to top-left, which is leftward/upward across 'packing_entry'; per the line definition this is direction 'to_left'.
No maximum interval between waiting and crossing was specified, so within_ms is null.
Cars that never cross the stop line pass, using IMPLIES(OCCURS(crossing), BEFORE(waiting, crossing)).
result: Muse Wonder also reads 'wait' as standing still in the traffic context; both readings give identical per-object verdicts
